turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here? Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Owen is kind. That's not why I'm here. Why is there a zero on his essay?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
That's a leading question, Hale, and the answer is no. My child doesn't lie, and you've just said he cheated without showing me one document. What do you have?
